_meta.description: Field schema for the information requested by the questions. No values are filled in: a separate facts file produced by code must use these field names and types; null = unknown.

types.real: real number in the given unit
types.map: data-dependent keys described by key; every value follows items
types.list: ordered list; every element follows items

_meta.units: SI unless stated: m, m2, m3, mm, kW, deg, kgCO2e, %. Imperial drawing sets use ft2 and ft-in strings as written on the sheet.
_meta.origin: origin external = data normally not contained in the drawing or BIM model (certificates, tests, product data, design loads, external databases). If an outcome depends only on external data it is CONDITIONAL; if it depends on missing design data it is NOT VERIFIABLE.
_meta.known_values: labels seen in the source drawings; other values are allowed
